title: test doubles: a limit-blind ObjectQL find double in a plugin-sharing testkit sits outside both double gates, which walk *.test.ts only
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #23181 slice 30 dev (os-dev-report `6555141723` on #23181), measured by a probe that was restored. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

**What was measured.** Both gates that hold test doubles to the real engine's contract discover doubles only in test files:
- `scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs` `walk()` admits `/\.(test|spec)\.(ts|tsx|mts)$/`.
- `scripts/check-objectql-double-limit.mjs` `testFilesUnder()` admits `/\.test\.ts$/`.

The repo keeps 62 shared kits under `__tests__/*.testkit.ts` (and similar), which neither gate reads. With both walks widened to `*.testkit.ts` (probe only, not committed; output in `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s30/odl-widen.log`), `check:objectql-double-limit` reports:

> `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/exec-context-seam.testkit.ts`: NEW ObjectQL `find` double that does not hold the caller's bound (1 blind, 0 breaking a shape rule, 0 unjudged). line 58: BLIND

So one limit-blind `find` double is live today outside the gate meant to catch it.

**Two questions for triage.**
1. The plugin-sharing double: make it hold `limit` by presence (or throw on a bound it does not implement), as the gate's own advice says.
2. Whether the two double gates should also walk testkit files. That widens what two existing gates enforce, so it is not a seat call (「新增门禁默认否」). The slice 30 report's option A measured the cost: one regex in `check-engine-double-contract` (rows move cleanly with `--write`), and in `check-objectql-double-limit` the regex, `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` and its `--self-test` `DECLARED_TAIL` pin, plus paying any limit debt the widened walk surfaces (the baseline only shrinks).

**Not affected by this card.** Slice 30 is re-ordered to keep plugin-auth's shared double in its `.test.ts` file (seat ruling on #23181), so nothing there leaves either gate's sight.
